summary: Alpha Modus Holdings filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K disclosing litigation updates rather than a special situation. The company reported that courts denied motions to dismiss in its subsidiary's patent infringement suits: on August 21, 2026 the Western District of Texas denied MNTN's Section 101 motion, and on September 29-30, 2026 the Eastern District of Texas adopted recommendations denying motions by 7-Eleven, Johnson Controls, Sensormatic, Lowe's, Kroger, and Creative Realities on Section 101, infringement, and venue grounds. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. Watch for litigation milestones and any monetization or settlement path.
